description: ASGS is the StormSurgeLive project's software for automating coastal ocean models and supporting operational storm-surge forecasts. It contains preprocessing and post-processing command-line tools and the asgsh environment for managing ADCIRC installations, configurations and runs. Inputs are model assets and run profiles; outputs are automated modelling runs and processed forecast products. Geographic coverage and forecast timing depend on the configured ADCIRC domain and forcing. Source is free under GPL-3.0 through GitHub. A limitation is that a functioning installation still needs compatible ADCIRC builds and local assets; automation alone does not establish forecast accuracy or operational readiness. The package supports coastal-infrastructure hazard assessment and emergency-response modelling. ADCIRC (model-adcirc) is its documented engine. The quick-reference wiki was inspected, but no forecast, notification, installation or external service connection was initiated.
